title: Staff Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
description:
ABOUT US

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents.

Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services.

All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down.

The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on-call.

ABOUT YOU

You're a staff-level engineer who wants to own systems, not tickets. You've built high-traffic, low-latency Python services and carried the pager for them. You think in trade-offs: latency versus cost, flexibility versus a public API that customers can't afford to see break, the fix that ships this week versus the architecture that has to last two years. You can lead work that spans several engineers and several quarters, you enjoy mentoring others, and you're fine when a problem shows up half-defined. You don't mind being the one who reads the spec for some unfamiliar protocol, works out how it fits, and designs an integration that holds up at scale. You change your mind when someone has a better argument, you make the people around you better, and you still care about your code long after it merges.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Own the technical direction of one or more of our services - architecture, performance, and reliability.

- Lead design of new systems and public APIs, and the evolution of existing ones as traffic and feature scope grow.

- Raise the engineering bar through design and code review, and mentor mid and senior engineers into owning bigger scopes.

- Partner with product, other engineering teams, and solutions/support to shape what we build and to represent search constraints and trade-offs honestly.

- Take part in on-call for the systems you own, and lead incident response and follow-through when things break.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

TECHNICAL

- Substantial experience building and operating high-traffic, low-latency backend services in production.

- Extensive Python knowledge (our primary language).

- Experience with observability and performance work in live systems.

- Experience designing and evolving public APIs that external customers depend on.

- Experience designing & implementing scalable service-oriented architectures.

BEYOND THE CODE

- Track record of leading projects that span multiple engineers and quarters.

title: TECH401: Security and Data Protection Lead
description:
About JerseySTEM

All JerseySTEM roles are pro-bono (unpaid) positions.
Areas of Focus - Technical Operations, Governance, Data Privacy

• Identity & Access Management: Implement and manage robust authentication services and access controls to ensure only authorized contributors have access to sensitive systems.

• Cybersecurity Risk Management: Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and manage the remediation of technical security gaps across the organization's platforms.

• Incident Response: Serve as the primary responder for security incidents, developing and maintaining the organizational incident response plan to minimize impact.

• Security Architecture: Oversee the technical focus of cloud-based security configurations, ensuring tools like Google Workspace and other internal systems are hardened against threats.

• Data Protection Framework: Develop and enforce policies specifically tailored to data protection, ensuring compliance with relevant privacy standards and best practices.

• Risk Governance: Translate high-level strategic direction into actionable policies and procedural documentation that can be easily followed by non-technical volunteers.

• Awareness & Culture: Drive security awareness training for all JerseySTEM members, fostering a culture of "Security First" across the organization.

• Insider Threat Mitigation: Establish monitoring and auditing processes to protect against internal data leakage and unauthorized data sharing.

Overview
Membership is a minimum six-month commitment of approximately 6-8 flexible hours per week and includes a $100 refundable deposit, returned after six months of active membership. K-12 educators, retirees, veterans, interns, and students are exempt from the deposit. JerseySTEM is a mission-driven professional network of pro-bono contributors dedicated to improving access to STEM education and career pathways for underserved middle school girls in New Jersey.
Members contribute their professional skills and leverage their networks in service of the organization’s gender-equity agenda. Role Overview Reporting to The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Security and Data Protection Lead is a high-impact role designed for an experienced professional who can bridge the gap between strategic direction and technical execution. You will be responsible for safeguarding JerseySTEM ’s digital assets and ensuring the privacy of our community's data.
This role blends hands-on implementation with tactical oversight, focusing on building a practical framework programs and policies for our security posture while maintaining the agility required for a non-profit environment.
Qualifications
Qualifications & Requirements

• 8+ years of proven experience in cybersecurity, information security, or data privacy roles.

• Ability to work independently as a “doer”, taking ownership of tasks from conception to completion.

• Strong understanding of technical security controls (IAM, encryption, network security) and governance frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001).

• Partner with the JerseySTEM TECH and non-technical team to prioritize and incorporate security perspectives into tools and workflows

• Draft, socialize, and maintain right-sized security policies, standards, and procedures appropriate for a nonprofit organization.

• Stay current on evolving threats (including AI-enabled threats) and share relevant, actionable recommendations with leadership and technical teams.

• Excellent communication skills to advise leadership on security architecture and risk.

• Comfortable working in a fully remote, member-driven organization.

• Commitment: Ability to dedicate approximately one working day (6-8 hours) per week to have a tangible impact.

• Relevant certifications are a plus but not required (e.g., CISSP, CISM, Security+, CCSP, GIAC).

• Exposure to AI/ML security considerations helpful, not required.

Hunter is looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our fully remote team. This role is about using email, social, channel, and paid to help users reach their a-ha moment in the product, increase usage, and generate revenue.
You’ll be the go-to person for all things lifecycle, owning the strategy and execution of this critical area.
You’ll report to the Head of Marketing, and work alongside a cross-departmental team: Ana (Account Manager), Antonio, Chris (Design), Gio (Head of Customer Success), Istvan (Design), Jeanro, Matt (CEO), Rui (Product Manager), and Ziemek.
Requirements
At Hunter , Marketing is a core part of how we generate brand affinity and revenue.
Hunter sits in a highly-competitive category with increasing noise, but thanks to its lineage as a first mover in 2015, it is an established, trusted brand.
In this role, you'll cut through that noise, joining a team of enthusiastic, highly-skilled marketers who take pride in their role as a caretaker of the brand. The touch points that we have with our users, as a trusted voice in a sea-of-sameness, are critical to growing the loyalty that millions of users have with Hunter .
Your goal is to own the entire lifecycle of our users so that more eyeballs see Hunter , more users find, verify, and send emails using the platform, API, and MCP server, and our brand continues to be the trusted voice in this category.
How marketing works at Hunter

Hunter 's marketing has grown from SEO foundations. Over the last two years, more activity in research, content, email marketing, paid media, and affiliates have contributed to incredible growth.
Your task is to work on the onboarding and nurture engine that engages our users to promote our content, convert free users to paid plans, and increase the lifetime value of our users.
In this role, you need deep knowledge of this category, user empathy, and the stakeholder & project management skills to work with the Head of Marketing, Head of Customer Success, Product Manager, and our marketing team to deliver growth measured in free>paid conversion rate, lifetime value, and retention.
You'll walk into an established onboarding and nurture engine, dozens of campaigns, and co-marketing opportunities, and immediately hit the ground running, firstly by reviewing and creating rapid improvements to onboarding and nurturing, before turning your attention to planning and executing critical Q1 campaigns.
Ownership areas include:

• Email marketing (onboarding, nurturing, retention, win-back, newsletters, and promotional)

• Cold email marketing

• Co-marketing with partners

• Affiliate marketing campaigns

• Social media

• Written and video content creation (inc. blogs and webinars)

• Reporting and insights

What you’ll do:

•
Own the user journey: You'll work cross-department to own the full user journey - from search and account creation, through to converting to a paid plan, increasing usage, and limiting churn - leveraging the full channel mix to engage, educate, and nurture users.

•
Increase free-to-paid conversions: Your core measurement is the ability to convert free user to a paid plan.

•
Establish and improve the nurture engine : You'll build a nurture engine that leverages user-behavior and persona signals to deliver personalized communications that builds brand affinity.

•
Promote content, research, and playbooks : You'll distribute highly-valuable content to help our users be more effective in their outreach, promoting webinars, guides, playbooks, the Outfoxed podcast, and monthly research.

•
Sales enablement : You'll identify users who might need help getting started, maximizing their plan, or with multiple users from their account and proactively engage them to support sales pipeline generation.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds - an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description: About Orakl Oncology Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials and every failure costs patients years. Orakl exists to change those odds. We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients: real patients’ tumors, paired with their medical history and deep biological data. Because we can test treatments on these virtual patients at scale, we can predict, with causal evidence, how a patient will respond to a drug long before it reaches the clinic. This helps pharma companies bet on the right drugs, for the right patients, much earlier on. We were founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès and Gustave Ronteix, PhD as a spin-out from Gustave Roussy, one of Europe’s leading cancer centers, and we build on 10 years of research. We are backed by top international VCs and growing fast. Discover more here on Orakl’s website . The role Orakl is looking for a Senior Business Development Manager to build and run its partnership pipeline with pharma and biotech. You will find the right accounts, reach the right people inside them and turn first conversations into qualified opportunities for the VP Business Development. You will own the front end of Orakl’s commercial engine: account strategy, prospecting, discovery and pipeline discipline. You will work closely with the VP BD, the Product Marketer, the scientific teams and the founders, and alongside the Communications & Events Lead on conferences. title: Humanitarian Immigration Attorney - T Visa, U Visa & VAWA
description:
Help survivors of trafficking, violence and crime find safety and legal status.
Mangone Law Firm is expanding its humanitarian relief team and is hiring attorneys who already know T visa, U visa and VAWA work. You will handle your own caseload, appear before USCIS and immigration courts, and work with a dedicated paralegal and legal support team.
About Us
Mangone Law Firm, LLC is a New Jersey-based immigration law firm serving clients nationwide since 2012. We were named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies. We combine strong systems, ongoing training and a mission-driven culture so our attorneys can focus on strategy and clients.
Requirements

What You’ll Do

• Lead case strategy and conduct initial case reviews and consultations.

• Review and approve packets, declarations and motions: T visa, U visa, VAWA, SIJS, family-based petitions, consular processing, waivers, RFEs and NOIDs.

• Represent clients at USCIS interviews, immigration court hearings (EOIR), bond hearings, and file motions and appeals (BIA, motions to reopen/reconsider).

• Give feedback to paralegals and legal assistants to keep work accurate and on time.

• Serve as Attorney of the Day, guiding the legal and consultation teams.

What You Bring

• Must have: Active U.S. bar license in good standing (any state).

• Must have: 2+ years of attorney experience handling T visa, U visa and/or VAWA cases.

• Must have: Fluent English and Spanish (written and spoken).

• Must have: Comfort appearing before USCIS and immigration courts.

• Nice to have: I-918B/I-914B certification work, SIJS, asylum, cancellation of removal, waivers; CAST or ASISTA training; case management experience (we use Camplegal, training provided); Google Workspace and Slack.

Not sure you meet every requirement? If you have a bar license and hands-on T, U or VAWA experience, we want to hear from you.
Benefits
What we offer you:

• Competitive Salary: And a mission-driven work environment.

• Health, dental, vision and life insurance.

• 401(k) with employer match and a pension plan.

• Paid time off, holidays and sick leave.

• Bar membership renewal coverage and tuition reimbursement.

• Structured 30/60/90/120-day onboarding and continuous training (CAST, ASISTA and more).

• Support from paralegals and legal assistants on every case.

title: Merchant Growth Specialist
description:
Make sure every restaurant on SOUS grows its revenue, across Uber Eats, Just Eat Takeaway and its own direct ordering channel.
Full-time
About SOUS
SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.
Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's.
Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception.
We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa.
About the role
Our promise to restaurants is simple: SOUS helps you grow. That means more visibility in AI search, more direct orders without commission, and a stronger performance on the delivery platforms restaurants already use. As our merchant base grows quickly, we want every single restaurant to see that growth in its numbers.

title: Director of Revenue Accounting & Assurance
description:
ABOUT STORD

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord , brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord ’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.
Stord is hiring a Director of Revenue Accounting & Assurance to own how we recognize, record and defend revenue across a business that blends warehousing, fulfillment, parcel and software. There is no dedicated revenue accounting team today, so you will own the function from day one: set the technical accounting position under ASC 606, and build the assurance program that gives our CFO, auditors and board confidence in every revenue number we report. What You'll Do

Revenue accounting

• Own the monthly and quarterly revenue close, including accruals for usage-based fulfillment, storage, transportation and parcel charges, and unbilled revenue.

• Own ASC 606 analysis for new and amended customer contracts (MSAs, SOWs, pricing schedules): performance obligations, principal vs. agent, variable consideration, contract modifications and software vs. services allocation.

• Own the revenue recognition policy, technical memos and the revenue recognition playbook, and keep them current as the product mix changes.

• Own the reserves for customer credits (such as service and SLA credits), including the estimation methodology, monthly true-ups and support for auditors.

• Own revenue analytics: revenue by customer, service line and contract, flux and trend analysis, and the metrics that explain revenue movement to Finance leadership.

• Partner with Billing and Systems to make sure contract terms, rate cards and billing data flow accurately into the general ledger.

Assurance and Controls

• Design, run and continuously improve the revenue control environment: SOX-readiness controls, reconciliations, billing-to-GL tie-outs and revenue completeness checks.

• Build an assurance program that tests revenue before it reaches the auditors, using data and analytics to catch billing leakage, duplicate charges and rate-card variances.

• Be the primary revenue contact for external auditors: PBC lists, walkthroughs, technical accounting positions and remediation of findings.

• Prepare for audit, diligence and potential IPO readiness requirements, including disclosures and footnote support.

Leadership

• Lead and scale the revenue accounting function: hands-on today, with any team build-out to be determined as business needs evolve.

• Drive automation of revenue workflows, reconciliations and flux analysis with the finance systems stack.

• Brief the CFO and Controller on revenue trends, risks and judgments.

title: PhD in AI / Earth Observation / Environmental Science
company: University of Cambridge, University of Manchester
description: University of Cambridge, University of Manchester | PhD in AI / Earth Observation / Environmental Science | ONSITE | UK home fee status only | £30k tax-free annual stipend Our group at Cambridge works on Earth Observation foundation models (Tessera: v1 https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.20380 , v2 https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03949 , https://geotessera.org/ ) and we've started a collaboration with Manchester to understand how they can be used to improve pollution models and then environmental decision making in general. This involves training new models and doing high-resolution inference across national or even global scales, as well as figuring out how to use that data to help policymakers make better decisions. As part of this work we have a PhD studentship through the joint Manchester-Cambridge Centre for Doctoral Training for AI in Decision Making for Complex Systems. This involves one year at Manchester doing taught postgraduate study and then three years at Cambridge for the PhD. Our work is all open source and involves solving significant compute and data challenges. Training our current-generation model takes ~250k GPU hours and a single year of global inference needs to move over 5.5 petabytes of data through the inference pipeline. This project would suit someone with strong machine learning and software engineering experience. We can help you build the atmospheric science and Earth Observation skills. We are a highly collaborative group who spend our time not only on foundational research but also on developing applications with practitioners and decision makers. Our work sees use in many industrial, academic and government environments for problems like crop classification, tree species mapping and change detection. You can find out more here: https://www.findaphd.com/phds/project/from-satellite-to-stre... - if you have questions about the project you can contact me, Sadiq Jaffer, at sj514@cam.ac.uk . For questions about the application process you'll want aidecisionscdt@manchester.ac.uk . Application deadline is Friday 4th of December with a course start date of September 2027.

description:
Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo - powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy:  Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

• High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

• Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

• Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use  boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

What you’ll do

As a Security Engineer at Privy, you will help keep a rapidly growing platform secure through hands-on investigation, operational ownership, and building real code to solve real problems. You’ll work across security operations, incident response, application and infrastructure security, and internal tooling.

This is not a role limited to reviewing logs and designs or simply escalating findings. You will carry real ownership for the day-to-day work that protects Privy: investigating anomalies, improving security workflows, and building the automation that makes the team faster and more effective over time. You’ll work closely with engineers across Privy and alongside specialists in cryptography, application security, offensive security, and infrastructure security to turn security expertise into practical, durable outcomes.

tenure.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join Motorway's Product & Engineering team. Motorway is a UK online car-selling platform connecting private sellers with ~7,500 verified dealers through online auctions. You will own a problem area end to end, in either the seller or the dealer side of the marketplace, and be accountable for the outcomes you deliver.

Building is cheaper than it has ever been. The hard part now is choosing the right thing to build. We want PMs with exceptional product sense who find the problems worth solving, back that judgement with evidence, and use the latest technology to solve them in ways that weren't possible a year ago.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

FIND THE PROBLEMS THAT MATTER

- Identify the highest-impact problem areas by combining quantitative analysis with qualitative research, and explain clearly why they matter more than the alternatives

- See through the hundreds of good ideas to the few that will move the business and create real value for sellers and dealers

- Own outcome-based goals and metrics, not feature lists

BUILD WITH AI, IN YOUR WORK AND IN OUR PRODUCT

- Use AI to make yourself and your team faster: automate routine PM tasks, analyse data and research quickly, and prototype or vibe code solutions to get customer feedback in days, not weeks

- Ask how each product could be built differently given what AI makes possible, and bring those ideas to your squad

- Make your team 2x more effective, not 2x busier

DELIVER WITH RIGOUR

- Lead a cross-functional squad of engineers, designers and data specialists from discovery through launch and measurement

- Run experiments that produce learning even when they fail, and act on what you learn

- Make clear trade-offs between customer needs, technical constraints and business priorities

BRING PEOPLE WITH YOU

- Communicate the what, the why and the how clearly, through crisp, data-led documents and conversations

- Work with the people closest to you (engineering, design, data) and with execs and other business units such as Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Marketing

- Influence without authority and build alignment on difficult decisions

REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience as a product manager, with a track record of shipping products that moved meaningful business metrics, not just delivering features

- Strong product sense. You can show how you found and prioritised the right problem, and what you chose not to do

- Comfortable with both qualitative and quantitative evidence: you run user research and also query data, design experiments and interpret results yourself

- Data-oriented. You use data to understand problems, set goals and measure impact, and can debate approaches with data scientists and analysts

- AI-forward. You use AI tools regularly in your own work and have hands-on experience prototyping or building with them. You have a point of view on where AI helps and where it doesn't

- A clear, confident communicator who can work with engineers and analysts day to day and with senior leaders across the business

- Ability to move between detail and strategy without losing coherence

- Self-starter with strong ownership, a curious mindset, and the ability to build domain knowledge quickly

- Experience in marketplaces, consumer products or B2B pl

title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
About XYPN

XYPN is the only turnkey advice and planning platform that makes it possible for fee-only financial advisors to build the independent firm of their dreams with complete autonomy. We do this through ongoing advocacy and access to education and training, curated technology, compliance support, community, and back-office and client support services.

This is an opportunity to join a company on a mission to help others-and you-live your best lives.

About the role

As the Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you shape how members experience XYPN at every stage, from the final sales call and onboarding through the ongoing journey of running and scaling their firms. Operating on the belief that members stay when they consistently see and feel the value of their membership, you will partner with the Director of Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders to define the lifecycle strategy and own the execution: the automated programs, segmented campaigns, and member communications that keep that value visible and top of mind.

Using data on member behavior, engagement, and lifecycle stage, you will design and run the journeys, campaigns, and testing that guide members toward deeper benefit adoption and stronger engagement with XYPN, at scale, across the full member base.

You are a storyteller as much as a strategic thinker, committed to learning our members and the realities of running a fee-only RIA. You will craft on-brand communications that inform, inspire, and drive action. Across every touchpoint, from emails to town halls to messaging at XYPN events, you make sure members feel that human connection.

Serving as the primary subject-matter expert for lifecycle marketing across the organization, you will collaborate and work cross-functionally with key departments and stakeholders across the organization, keeping members engaged and supported at every stage.

Where We Hire: We’re excited to review applications from across the U.S., but we give priority to candidates residing in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MN, MT, NC, NE and TX.

What you'll be doing

Lifecycle Marketing Strategy

• Develop and execute the lifecycle strategy for XYPN Emerald and Sapphire members (onboarding, benefit activation, retention, reactivation, expansion).

• Drive adoption of benefits, services, and premium offerings via targeted campaigns.

• Refine member segmentation models using CRM attributes, lifecycle stage, behavioral data, and member-stated interests.

• Maintain communication governance, including audience selection, channel strategy, messaging, contact frequency, and a member preference strategy that lets members choose the communications they receive.

• Consult on demand gen and prospect campaigns with the Sales and Marketing teams and support strategic initiatives as needed.

Campaigns & Marketing Automation

• Design, build, and run recurring, triggered, and automated campaigns across email, member Portal, and other member channels.

• Manage core journeys, including onboarding sequences, weekly member communications, benefit adoption campaigns, and cross-sell programs.

• Manage the member communications calendar, coordinating cadence across all member-facing campaigns and keeping messaging aligned with the prospect marketing team.

• Own marketing communications for twice-yearly Townhalls, XYPN events, and the annual XYPN LIVE conference, driving member engagement and pass sales.

• Write clear, compelling copy in a warm, human voice that matches XYPN’s brand, and collaborate on asset production.

Member Insights, Reporting & Optimization

• Translate member research and performance metrics into actionable lifecycle recommendations

• Execute structured testing roadmaps (messaging, segmentation, timing, channels) to optimize engagement.

• Track and report on core lifecycle KPIs (retention, engagement, reactivation, LTV) to leadership.

• Analyze program outcomes to evaluate impact on member behavior and business goal

title: Senior Brand Designer
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Brand Designer to help shape how SpaceXSI shows up in the world. This role is built for someone who has built brand systems in fast-moving environments, cares deeply about craft, and brings an AI-first mindset to how creative work gets made. You’ll join the Brand Studio, the team behind the brand across the entire SpaceXSI ecosystem (from Grok and Grok Bot to X), and help shape both the brand system itself and how it comes to life in our campaigns.

This is a hands-on role. Much of the foundation is still being built, so you’ll spend real time designing and making things yourself. It also comes with significant ownership: you’ll lead projects from first concept through final execution, and your work will help set the bar for how the brand evolves.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Brand system: Evolve and extend the visual identity (logo, typography, color, layout, imagery, and graphic language) and document it so other teams can apply it correctly.

- Workflows & toolkits: Turn recurring design work into repeatable, AI-assisted workflows: templates, tools, and generators that let marketing, product, and other teams produce on-brand work without you in the room.

- Campaigns: Concept and design campaigns end to end, from first idea through final production, across key visuals, launch assets, web, social, paid, out-of-home, and print.

- Creative direction: Direct agencies and freelancers with clear briefs and candid feedback so the output meets the bar you’d set yourself.

- Collaboration: Partner with marketing, product, engineering, and leadership; bring a brand point of view to new surfaces as they appear, and present your thinking clearly to senior stakeholders.

- Range at speed: Move between projects quickly while holding a consistently high bar, and keep improving the process, not just the output.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 6+ years of brand design experience, in-house or at an agency or studio.

- Fluency in AI coding tools, especially Cursor. You can build your own tools, scripts, prototypes, and simple web pages instead of waiting on engineering.

- A portfolio that shows both brand system work and shipped campaigns. Bonus if it includes tools or workflows you built.

- Sharp typography, layout, and art direction instincts.

- A systems mindset: you naturally turn one-off tasks into reusable processes and think about how creative work scales.

- Conviction in your design decisions and the ability to explain why they matter, to designers, marketers, and leadership alike.

- Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud.

- Self-directed, fast, and energized by variety and ambiguity.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience building or relaunching a brand identity at a fast-growing tech company.

- Motion sensibility, enough to design with motion in mind and direct motion designers.

- Experience leading agencies on large, multi-channel campaigns.

title: Network and Security Engineer, Defense
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Network and Security Engineer to own the architecture of high-performance, high-assurance networks for our defense programs. You will design networks that move terabits of radar, camera, and vehicle data with low, predictable latency, and you will secure those networks to the standard needed for classified environments up to Impact Level 6 (IL6). This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who has spent a career solving hard networking and security problems and wants to keep doing so directly, while shaping technical direction across our defense programs and growing into broader technical leadership. At Applied, we encourage engineers to own technical and product decisions, work closely with customers and users, and contribute to a thoughtful, dynamic team culture.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

- Architect and build high-bandwidth network fabrics (100/400/800GbE) that carry mixed radar, EO/IR camera, and vehicle bus data from the sensor edge to compute and storage

- Design for deterministic, low-latency transport using techniques such as Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN), precision time synchronization (PTP/IEEE 1588), RDMA/RoCEv2, and multicast for sensor distribution

- Bridge in-vehicle networks (automotive Ethernet, CAN, and legacy military buses) with modern IP-based backbones in rugged, size- and power-limited platforms

- Design and implement security architectures that support IL5/IL6 accreditation, including network segmentation, encryption in transit (MACsec, IPsec, CSfC-style layered encryption), PKI, and cross-domain data flows

- Apply zero trust principles across on-prem, tactical edge, and cloud environments rather than relying on perimeter-only defenses

- Automate network and security configuration with infrastructure as code, and build continuous compliance checks into deployment pipelines in place of manual, document-driven processes

- Build observability into the network through streaming telemetry, flow analysis, and security monitoring so that problems and threats surface quickly

- Translate Navy and DoD guidance into practical engineering decisions, adopting the intent of those standards while pushing toward modern, maintainable solutions

- Work directly with customers, government stakeholders, and product teams across Applied to understand mission needs and deployment constraints

- Set the technical roadmap for defense networking and security, lead design reviews, mentor engineers across teams, and serve as a trusted technical voice with customers and government stakeholders

Overview
The Accounts Receivables Insurance Specialist 1 manages the accounts receivable in accordance with compliance, regulatory and billing guidelines and specific payer rules. Responsible for collection of outstanding receivables through payer portals and/or phone lines. Responsible for the accurate billing of insurance claims by validating coverage, resolving charge review edits, claim edits and front-end clearinghouse and payer rejections. In addition, follows up on outstanding receivables; completes basic appeals; answers, documents and completes inquiries from, insurance companies, internal departments, and 3rd party payers. Works collaboratively with other departments such as Billing, Coding, Cash Posting, etc. to ensure claims are processed/paid correctly. Responsibilities
Ability to take initiative but also accept direction and seek guidance appropriately. Ability to manage confidential information with sensitivity and discretion (in a HIPAA-compliant way). Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills. Timely and accurate claims submissions to health insurance carriers for community, government and commercial health plans as assigned, in the form of electronic and paper billing. Timely and accurate submissions of non-complex reconsiderations and/or appeals to health insurance carriers for community, government and commercial health plans as assigned, via paper, fax or web portal. Monitoring, researching, and resolving unpaid, rejected, denied and/or allowance discrepancy claims. Responsible for all aspects of account follow up and collections, as assigned. Ability to analyze accounts and determine the next appropriate action for account resolution. Accurately and thoroughly document the pertinent collection activities in the billing system. Determines and initiates appropriate action to resolve denied and/or rejected invoices, or invoices in allowance discrepancy and prepares payer corrections and/or appeals in accordance with payer plan requirements using electronic and paper processes. Utilizes clinical applications, payer websites and other systems as a research tool to retrieve medical documentation, patient eligibility information, billing guidelines, patient referrals, and hospital or procedure code authorizations to substantiate corrected claims submissions, through written appeals, and coding reviews, etc. Review account level undistributed payments for application to open balances as it applies to assigned payer(s). Reviews and resolves incoming correspondence. Identifies, prepares and appropriately requests adjustments. Responds to inquiries from patients, insurance companies, public agencies, internal departments and 3rd party payers. Identifies and resolves insurance set up errors to facilitate timely billing. Resolves charge review edits, claim edits and clearinghouse and payer rejections to facilitate accurate billing, as assigned. Evaluates Credit/Balance accounts and performs appropriate action to resolve, including but not limited to sending refunds and/or initiating payer recoupments via web portal. Evaluates accounts in an allowance discrepancy status against system loaded contract. Meticulously prepares appeals for appropriate reimbursement from payers. May prepare adjusted and corrected bills, adjust accounts receivable entries, or prepare refunds in accordance with existing operating procedures. May be required to answer calls coming into the department through a rotation line. Will assist or direct callers to the appropriate representative to resolve issues. Performs other duties as assigned. Qualifications
